name: eldoria-dev-tests
description: Dev-only test harness. The game itself has zero dependencies.

scripts.assets:build: node tools/process-crop-sheet.mjs && node tools/process-ranger-source.mjs && node tools/process-ranger-walk-source.mjs
scripts.assets:verify: node tools/process-crop-sheet.mjs --check && node tools/process-ranger-source.mjs --check && node tools/process-ranger-walk-source.mjs --check && npm run assets:manifest:check
scripts.test: npm run ranger-proof:integrity && npm run ranger-proof:self-test && python tools/npc-static-contract-test.py && node tools/smoke-test.mjs && node tools/npc-sprite-test.mjs && node tools/iso-test.mjs && node tools/dumpling-compliance-test.mjs && node tools/terrain-test.mjs && node tools/playtest-fixes-test.mjs && node tools/audio-bulkbuy-test.mjs && node tools/zoom-speed-test.mjs && node tools/adaptive-joystick-test.mjs && node tools/profile-state-test.mjs && node tools/combat-progression-test.mjs && node tools/identity-progression-test.mjs && node tools/onboarding-test.mjs && node tools/asset-manifest-test.mjs && node tools/armor-hearts-test.mjs
scripts.verify:all: npm test && npm run assets:verify && npm run ranger-proof:candidate
